reviewer: Kimi Code recovery review subagent; actually viewed the full exact source, complete unchanged raw, full white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha comparison sheet and naiwa reference, inspected native-resolution raw detail regions, and verified the recorded evidence, source PNG, output, task, prompt, request, result and sheet SHA-256 values plus image metadata with read-only Python.

entries.positive_observation: The source's slight viewer-left/up head direction, gaze and stern single closed mouth are retained on a compact yellow mascot with green-ringed solid black eyes and no human skin, nose or ears. Dark-brown swept-back hair, receding hairline, short sideburns, dark brows, round dark-framed glasses and a smooth clean-shaven face remain. The dark charcoal suit, pale-blue pointed shirt collar and dark navy tie retain the source composition, with no decorations added. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a neck column, pinching, floating cloth or cream bib. The complete dark frame and opaque blue-charcoal backing remain. The note preserves the visible two-upper-block/two-lower-block grouping and original blank spaces, with the compact dark right-edge tab restored and no substitute fold or extra writing fragments.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept the native RGBA transparent exterior outside the complete frame/note silhouette under visible-alpha-v1. Full white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha inspection shows no visible interior holes, lost backing, clothing transparency or working-matte halo. Actual returned extrema [0, 254] are retained; internal 252-254 values are not treated as defects. No source-alpha replacement was performed or is required.
entries.visible_limitations: The note glyphs, fine tie weave and finest glasses-rim detail are not reliably readable at source scale. Approval is based on the actually visible block grouping, eyewear, hair, facial features, clothing, pose, collar, note, tab, frame and backing; no unreadable tiny detail was used as a rejection or as a claim of readable text.
